spectrum.definition: P0(k) = A k^n exp(-(k R_c)^2) at a_init (k in 1/box-length-units)

units.expansion: Einstein-de Sitter: H = H0 a^-3/2, dt = a^(1/2) da / H0

equations: dx/dt = p/a^2, dp/dt = -grad(phi)/a, laplacian(phi) = C delta with C = 3/2 H0^2 (comoving x, canonical momentum p = a^2 dx/dt); linear growth a^2 D'' + 3/2 a D' - C/H0^2 D = 0 => D = a, D_- = a^-3/2
integrator: KDK leapfrog with merged kicks (Quinn et al. 1997): kick factor int dt/a = 2(a2^1/2 - a1^1/2), drift factor int dt/a^2 = 2(a1^-1/2 - a2^-1/2); steps uniform in ln a (0.004 <= dln a <= 0.01; real time accumulates until a step is due) clamped onto snapshot epochs

pm.green: phi_k = -C delta_k S(k) / (k^2 W_cic(k)^2), k=0 removed

initial_conditions: Zel'dovich from a side x side particle lattice (cell-centred, offset half a lattice spacing; side = the multiple of mesh/2 nearest to sqrt(requested particles), so the lattice is commensurate with the mesh and its CIC harmonics alias only onto k=0/Nyquist); fixed-amplitude Gaussian field |delta_k| = sqrt(P0(k)/L^2) with random phases from a seeded white-noise field (Hermitian by construction), k = 0 and Nyquist row/column zeroed; displacement Psi_k = i k delta_k / k^2 deconvolved by the CIC window, CIC-interpolated to the lattice; x = q + (a/a_init) Psi, p = H0 a^(3/2) Psi / a_init

pk_measurement.binning: log-spaced from the fundamental 2pi/L to the Nyquist pi N/L; mean k per bin; modes on the Nyquist row/column excluded
pk_measurement.cadence: every 0.05 in ln a plus at snapshot epochs and a_final

pk_columns: a,k,P_measured,P_linear,n_modes; P_linear = (a/a_init)^2 * <P0(k)> over the bin's modes (exact expectation for the fixed-amplitude ICs)
snapshot_format: little-endian: 8-byte magic GSNAP001, u64 count, f32 a, f32 box, count x [f32 x, f32 y] comoving positions wrapped into [0, box), count x [f32 vx, f32 vy] peculiar velocities v = a dx/dt = p/a in box units per (1/H0)
notes: 2D cosmology (planar gravity with a 1/k^2 Poisson kernel). Lattice ICs have sub-Poisson noise, so subtracting the Poisson shot noise L^2/N_p under-estimates P at high k (it can go negative) until the particles have shell-crossed. Velocities in snapshots are synchronized with positions (partial kick). Internally the GPU stores each particle's f32 displacement from its lattice point (x = q + s) for precision; snapshots contain absolute positions. Run directory name is the UTC start time.
